paragraphs: The morning starts with business interviews and process mapping. Around midday, the analyst reviews interfaces and priorities with developers. The afternoon goes to solution writing and gap analysis. Evening brings pilot feedback, while the weekend often includes industry and competitor research.

In one sentence: translate business problems into system solutions. The work includes requirements research, gap analysis, solution design, development coordination, and prioritization. It requires both technical depth and communication.
